budgetAccounting.consumer: count roots/elements/locals/operations and ranges while verifying; full candidate input/output bounded8MiB; legacy stdin/MLIR parser runs before candidate discovery and is not independently resource-certified
budgetAccounting.producer: callbacks cover blocks, entry parameter count, registers, steps and every line; complete UTF8 header, metadata, wrappers, separators and final LF reserved; exactly8MiB accepted, overflow throws before returning any text
budgetAccounting.sharedSteps: E+2*C+4; receiver reference and index each consume one step
budgetAccounting.symbols: C=local count, E=element count in that function; all bodies have one final checked read

canonicalization: whole validation before bounded generic MLIR print; --optimize is identity: preserve every operation, SSA dependency, metadata, original alias chain, site, range and checked-read obligation; Node producer text is a separate deterministic generic-syntax representation, not asserted byte-equal to C++ generic printer output

diagnostics.nodeUpstream: explicit context, selected facts and complete HIR verified before reading HIR properties; existing r03-array-hir-* errors and trusted-only primaries pass through unchanged
diagnostics.precedence: MLIR parsing/registered operation traits may reject before private verifier; only isolated actually reached tags establish a specific private check; generic parser/trait failures are reported separately

formalBytecode.order: after successful complete candidate verification; no scalar/reference/nullable fallback

functions.anchors: name/return annotation are nonempty disjoint ordered ranges inside fn.range; complete local statements follow return annotation and precede final return; declaration ranges are ordered, disjoint, inside root extent
functions.body: entry fuel event1 at fn.range; 1..17 ordered locals, each root constants+create or one alias; receiver definition lookup then one u32 index constant, read_checked, final return at original return.range
functions.identity: all functions use module root sourcePath, existing global function ID, exact zero-param f64 signature and f64 type ID; source_binding uses original private binding hash over name_range
functions.ssa: all constants must be reached in their exact lexical order; create uses its immediately preceding ordered f64 constants only; alias uses exact prior target binding definition; read uses exact prior receiver binding definition and immediately preceding u32 index; return uses exact checked-read result; preserve every represented local even if unused later; no extra/detached constants or operations outside this complete local/read grammar
functions.type: zero parameters, one f64 result, one body region containing one block; no extra attributes, regions or successors

identity.comparison: prefixed lowercase sha256 digests exact; original Source binding/site IDs are recomputed, not accepted as arbitrary runtime handles
identity.finiteJCS: no final LF; binding keys nameRange,sourcePath; site keys range,sourcePath; nested keys end,start; range numbers canonical nonnegative base10 integers <=65536; JSON strings quote/backslash/short controls escaped, other controls lowercase u00xx, valid Unicode emitted unchanged UTF8 with no NFC normalization; slash not escaped; invalid/lone surrogate input rejected
identity.function: SHA256(UTF8(tsfg.function + NUL + root sourcePath + NUL + decoded function name + NUL + unprefixed signature hash))

limitsOfCredit: Owned Array HIR to static Core validation/canonicalization/identity optimization only. No Source re-admission from absent source content, runtime allocation/physical owner/storage/GC/ABI, bounds/trap/VM/AOT execution, formal wire success, RF/host witness or lifting of any existing cyber STOP.

localMetadata.nesting: statement inside function; statement.start<declaration.start=name.start; name inside declaration; initializer.end=declaration.end<=statement.end; annotation after name and before initializer, element annotation inside annotation; root create requires explicit nonempty annotation; locals source order, unique names and identities; alias optional annotation; declaration/initializer tail relations retain original ranges
localMetadata.ownership: create and alias each define precisely one distinct local binding; alias target is strictly earlier in same function; binding IDs including source function binding are package-unique
localMetadata.rangeFields: DenseI64ArrayAttr, two nonnegative signless i64 values [start,end], start<end; optional annotation fields both empty or both nonempty; empty form is array<i64>
localMetadata.scalarFields: id/name StringAttr; id is private Source binding identity; names well-formed nonempty UTF8 without NUL

marker.name: tsfg_core.array
marker.schema: sha256 of UTF8 JCS(this descriptor), without final LF

module.exports: one row per function sorted by unsigned UTF8 name bytes; exact {name:StringAttr,function_id:StringAttr}; same name/global ID pair as functions
forbidden: other candidate marker, dialect or nominal type, including unused/nested signature or attribute types
nested regions, extra blocks, parameters, external functions
module.functionIds: ordered array of every function global ID exactly once; source declaration order; no hidden or omitted Core function
module.inputIdentity: exact prefixed selected ArrayFacts packageId; request_id is exact prefixed selected facts requestId; without source text C++ validates their digest syntax, not their upstream preimages
module.sourceSelection: ordinary source path/hash/length selects the root row; exactly two sources sorted by unsigned UTF8 path bytes; one root .ts not .d.ts and one pinned minimal-arrays-v1.d.ts; root lies inside the declaration row parent directory
module.sources: exact rows {path:StringAttr,hash:StringAttr,utf16_length:signless i64}; valid normalized absolute POSIX well-formed UTF8 path without NUL/backslash; pinned DTS hash sha256:04a97584458d9212250e94d4fc517264c277a9ce635fbb14de11452194fd76b2 and extent312
module.types: ordered f64 then Array type origins, as specified by typeMetadata; u32 remains the existing nominal scalar, not an extra type-origin row

operations.anchors: operation range is original literal initializer inside local declaration; allocation_site is exact original private site ID; element ranges are strictly within literal, ordered nonoverlapping; literal extent>=2
operations.name: tsfg_array.create
operations.semantics: each reached literal creates a fresh shared owner; empty literal remains an allocation operation; equal element bits at different sites remain distinct; do not allocate physical storage or fold/DCE/merge here

operations.anchors: operation range is original reference initializer; target_binding maps to the exact reached operand definition in this function
operations.name: tsfg_array.alias
operations.semantics: same owner as operand, no allocation or element copy; retain every original alias as a separate SSA operation and original chain, not a collapsed root edge

operations.anchors: operation range is full checked read; starts at receiver_range.start; receiver_range.end<index.range.start and index.range.end<read.end; read is inside final return and follows its start
operations.name: tsfg_array.read_checked
operations.semantics: evaluate receiver then index once; retain reach-time bounds validation obligation before future element access; empty/equal-length/far-OOB indices are not evaluated, folded, compared to length or trapped by this consumer

scalarLeaves.credit: preserve original bit/decimal and original range; source tokens remain upstream HIR; C++ cannot rederive token semantics without source content

f64.value: StringAttr of exactly16 lowercase hex IEEE754 bits; finite only, signed zero and subnormals retained; no decimal conversion in C++

index.value: StringAttr canonical decimal0..4294967294, original exact-mathematical-integer token already checked upstream; no IEEE rounding, coercion or truncation

type.physicalStorage: opaque; allocation_site identifies a source expression, never a runtime owner handle

typeMetadata.encoding: each row DictionaryAttr; all scalar fields StringAttr; all range fields DenseI64ArrayAttr [start,end]
